threepl.simulator

Class SimTerminal

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.event.WindowAdapter
      • threepl.simulator.SimTerminal
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.awt.event.ActionListener, java.awt.event.WindowFocusListener, java.awt.event.WindowListener, java.awt.event.WindowStateListener, java.util.EventListener

    public class SimTerminal
extends java.awt.event.WindowAdapter
implements java.awt.event.ActionListener
    This class provides a read-only text terminal emulation. It interacts with the SimTraceLogger class to display trace log file data.
    Version:
    $Revision: 6003 $
    Author:
    Andrew Tulloh
